input.prompt: Using the reference photo only for the setting and the look: create the reverse angle of the same moment in the same home. Same entryway, same warm beige walls, same late-afternoon window light and warm color temperature, same chest-height camera, same smartphone lens feel and moderate depth of field, same production design and color grade. The woman from the reference is NOT in this frame. New subject: a man in his late 30s, a real-looking dad with natural proportions, not a model, not influencer-polished, short everyday haircut, light stubble. He has just come in through the front door, which is now behind him. A plain navy youth soccer duffel bag hangs from one shoulder, his hand on the strap, a pair of small kids' shin guards poking out of the open zipper. He looks off camera to screen-left with a matter-of-fact, slightly distracted expression and a small half-shrug, mouth just opening to speak. Not defensive-angry, not smiling for the camera. Simple neutral everyday clothing: a plain charcoal zip-up jacket over a grey tee, no logos, no printed text, no team crest or numbers on the bag. Because this is the reverse angle, the window light now falls from the right side of frame. Realistic skin texture, no retouching, no text anywhere.
